grammar_distinctions_required_by_cnc: C versus Q: CNC01 and CNC06 require separating admissibility/exposure constraints from criterion/alternative orientation.
K versus T: CNC03 has explicit ordering separate from mapping; CNC06 explicitly forbids inferring a sequential psychological update from conditioning on an observed example set.
P_out versus O: CNC03/CNC05 support O without a frozen probe, while CNC02/CNC04/CNC06 have explicit probe/read operations.
P_in versus internal K: no CNC claim requires an intervention/write role; source-to-target transfer and representational construction are K, not P_in.
Q need not be scalar: relevance filtering, systematicity preference and posterior alternative weighting fit Q without reward semantics.
C need not be resource/budget: CNC01 uses admissible grouping restriction; CNC05 architectural realizability; CNC06 sampling/observation admissibility.
Pi need not be physical, but it also must not be forced: only CNC05 provides subsystem-decomposition support and even there Pi remains PARTIAL because no frozen partition operator was required.
residual_structures_not_expressible_by_g: CNC05 r2 carries an explicit static differs predicate between two architecture alternatives. Grammar v0 can encode the configurations and their Pi/C difference only indirectly; it does not make the comparison predicate first-class.
possible_compression_or_derived_feature_: CNC01: explanatory knowledge simultaneously participates as X while inducing distinct C-like admissibility and Q-like relevance filtering.
CNC02: multiple read procedures compress to P_out with read targets distinguished as X versus O.
CNC03: relational/systematicity selection compresses into generalized non-scalar Q; its known bounded-XLike nonmembership does not block direct Grammar coverage.
CNC04: available-information and outcome nodes compress into one rho/O family differentiated by topology/stage; fitted numeric forms remain K refinements.
CNC05: shared-convergence necessity is a broader C specialization (architectural realizability), while subsystem decomposition is only a Pi candidate.
CNC06: sampling model -> C, prior/posterior alternative weighting -> Q, and repeated-example sharpening -> C-conditioned K without T.
potential_threats_to_grammar_v0: Grammar v0 is not yet a lossless general claim language for explicit comparison predicates such as CNC05 r2 'differs'; a relation-annotation layer may be required even when no new top-level cognitive role is needed.

The merged Lean skeleton is narrower than the Discussion-level scientific K/rho vocabulary for some cross-role and O-to-O dependencies (e.g. CNC02 X->O predictions and CNC06 O->O model/data relation). Technical carrier plumbing must not be counted as source-supported P/X roles.
Generalized C/Q must remain evidence-gated. The CNC mappings rely on explicit frozen topology; generic condition, necessity, weighting, or constraint vocabulary alone would overgenerate roles.

counterexample_to_grammar_v0.statement: No CNC claim requires a ninth top-level cognitive role on the frozen lane. CNC05 r2 is a bounded counterexample to treating Grammar v0 alone as a lossless full claim language because its explicit static comparison relation is only indirectly recoverable from X/Pi/C structure.
counterexample_to_grammar_v0.cnc03_statement: CNC03, despite being the only claim uncovered by bounded XLike reconstruction, is FULL under direct Grammar-v0 reverse projection; XLike family coverage and Grammar role coverage are therefore distinct tests.
